name: force-full-scan-consults-store
body: `Coordinator::force_full_scan` discards the derived index and rebuilds it by calling `cmd_scan` **without** `--force`, once the session has already released its handle, flock and socket. What it discards: the derived database `db.lbug` with its `.wal`/`.shm` sidecars, through the shared `discard_derived_index` (no export is discarded), before the scan takes the spec lock. With no `db.lbug` the freshness fast path cannot fire and the incremental preparation has no previous database to seed from, so no unsaved admission can be reused. Trigger: `abort` when the held database carried a dirty row or a pending-removal identity (the decision is read before anything is released), and `start`'s crash check. What it rebuilds: the derived index from the durable node files and freshly scanned code, through `pipeline::run_pipeline`. Limit: the rebuild still consults the shared fact store and may warm-reuse it, exactly as `apg scan` without `--force` does, so a divergence originating in the store rather than in the derived index is not healed here; upgrade by passing `--force` if a phantom projection is ever observed to survive a warm reuse after an abort.
